_comment: Allowlist for the media-tools image (D-16 as amended). Every component in the image must be listed. 'permissive' needs binaryLicence on check.py's permissive list; 'copyleft-exception' needs a reason and is the only way GPL/LGPL gets in: ffmpeg, x264 and their runtime libraries, as separate processes in our own containers, never linked into our code or distributed. AGPL, SSPL, non-commercial and non-free are banned in check.py and cannot be allowlisted. copyrightSha256 pins the copyright file a human reviewed: when it changes, the check fails until someone re-reads it. Regenerate with: python3 packages/media-tools/licenses/check.py --image media-tools:dev --print-shas. Fonts (kind 'font' in the inventory, P3-04) must be SIL OFL 1.1 ('permissive' with binaryLicence OFL-1.1); sourceSha256 pins the font file and copyrightSha256 its licence text (line endings normalised, as check.py reads it).

chrome-headless-shell.reason: chrome-headless-shell from Chrome for Testing: Chromium (BSD-3-Clause) with the third-party components built into it, some of them LGPL (its LICENSE file lists every one). Chrome and its libraries run as a separate process inside the media sandbox (the motion-graphics renderer, D-35); never linked into our code and never distributed. Pinned by version and by the SHA-256 of each architecture's archive.

ffmpeg.reason: Built --enable-gpl because libx264 is GPL. Runs as a separate process in our containers; never linked into our code and never distributed (D-16 amendment). Source: ffmpeg.org release tarball checked against sourceSha256.

libasound2t64.reason: A shared library chrome-headless-shell loads (directly or through GLib). Chrome and its libraries run as a separate process inside the media sandbox (the motion-graphics renderer, D-35); never linked into our code and never distributed.

libatomic1.reason: GCC runtime library, linked by the allowed tools. The GCC Runtime Library Exception lets programs link it without becoming GPL. Part of the container's OS layer, not our code.

Chrome and its libraries run as a separate process inside the media sandbox (the motion-graphics renderer, D-35); never linked into our code and never distributed.

libfribidi0.reason: Bidi text layout, a dependency of libass. Dynamically linked into the ffmpeg process only.

libgraphite2-3.reason: Graphite font shaping, a dependency of Debian's libharfbuzz (tri-licensed LGPL-2.1+/GPL-2+/MPL-1.1; used under the LGPL). Dynamically linked into the ffmpeg process only.
